## Guide pages in this domain

- [DSSS Burst Acquisition](../guide/dsss-acquisition.md) — acquiring a spread-spectrum preamble's code phase and Doppler with `BurstAcquisition`, and continuous signals with `Acquisition`

## Gallery pages in this domain

- [A Message Over DSSS, Received and Deframed](../gallery/data-source-link.md) — a data source sent one chunk per burst, received by `DsssBurstReceiver`, and returned byte for byte by `FrameDesc.deframe`.
- [AsyncDsssPool: emitters that come and go](../gallery/async-dsss-pool-demo.md) — three receivers, four emitters on one Gold code: each held by one receiver, a departure freeing its receiver, and the newcomer taking it, read from the pool's own status after every push.
- [AsyncDsssPool: ten emitters through six receivers](../gallery/async-dsss-pool-scene.md) — ten emitters on one Gold code, each on its own Doppler ramp and within ±8 dB of the others, come and go through six receivers: each held by one receiver from soon after it arrives, a freed receiver taking the next, and a weak emitter waiting for the strong one that masks it.
- [AsyncDsssReceiver: a signal's lifecycle](../gallery/async-dsss-receiver-lifecycle.md) — one packaged receiver through an emitter's life: searched, tracked through a fade, released when it departs, reset, and re-acquired on its return, read from its own state after every push
- [AsyncDsssReceiver: the specification link](../gallery/async-dsss-receiver-spec.md) — one packaged receiver on a link whose Doppler stretches the chip clock as well as the carrier, through both regimes of a pass: carrier-to-code aiding, a missed hand-off searched again, and the decode scored by BER, EVM and M2M4
- [DSSS Acquisition — Pd / Pfa vs Es/N0](../gallery/dsss-acq-characterization.md) — detection characterisation curves.
- [DsssBurstReceiver — the Composed Burst Chain](../gallery/dsss-burst-receiver.md) — the end-to-end DSSS burst walkthrough: a train sent from one frame description on all three `wfmgen` faces, then `BurstAcquisition -> refine -> BurstDemod` behind one `push()`, the same answer at every block size
- [DsssReceiver — the Composed Continuous DSSS Receiver](../gallery/dsss-receiver.md) — `Acquisition -> Dll(segments) -> RateConverter -> MpskReceiver` at real chip/symbol rates, collapsed into one `DsssReceiver` and one `steps()` call -- the despreader removes the code and an explicit resampler bridges it to a normal demodulator.
- [Streaming Async Despreader](../gallery/async-despread.md) — `Dll(segments)` despreading a Doppler-dilated code on an asynchronous data clock, unaided and with the carrier's rate aid.

## Design pages in this domain

- [AsyncDsssReceiver and AsyncDsssPool — continuous DSSS, from spec to object](../design/async-dsss-receiver.md) — continuous DSSS, from spec to object: the derived code period, the acquisition hand-off, the asynchronous despreader, the receiver's states, the pool's one search, what it costs and the status record
- [AsyncDsssReceiver and AsyncDsssPool — the measurement record](../design/async-dsss-receiver-measurements.md) — the dated runs behind the design page under the same section numbers: the pool's lock, arrival and cost runs (§6, §9), the pinned bench and the search profile, and every step of the receiver's build (§12)
- [DsssBurstReceiver: the burst chain, composed in C](../design/dsss-burst-receiver.md) — the burst chain composed in C: the three-stage `search → refine → demod` shape, why the hand-off needs a never-late epoch, and what a burst `DetectionEvent` must carry to stand alone
- [The Polynomial-Phase Estimator — the reasoning](../design/ppe.md) — the feedforward frequency/chirp-rate estimate a burst gets exactly one of: why the search is two-dimensional and coherent, why the transform is 4x its input, and why the caller strips the modulation
